versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei抖音数据获取器 (guaikei-douyin-data-getter).
- Provides four main capabilities: search (videos/images/users), post (author’s posts), comment (video comments), and hot (trending topics).
- Clear scenarios and generic triggers for short video research, competitor analysis, and hot topic discovery, even if Douyin is not mentioned.
- Strict token management and error handling requirements for compliance and security.
- Command-line interface with structured JSON output and schema validation.
- Supports workflow integration for competitive and sentiment analysis.
